review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.rationale: 当前双方骑士决斗真实进入清异常、下次实际技能转化且原槽PP保留、无可选第五技能无法用招、控制/药剂保留与整招无效实际使用消费、当前死亡转落败/解除敌决斗/被击败反制抑制及即时重生例外均已验证。高低等HP回合快照、全强PP恢复、低体先制与全回无视正强已测；技能2505当前额度已按面板速度确认并实现，覆盖免疫仍消费、原始候选抽样及未用不消费。
review.singleBehavior: 首次登场双方都无骑士类状态才附决斗；依据API357转化技能但PP沿原选择槽，排序使用第五技能先制。当前低体按回合快照先制1及无视敌正能力，严格高体全一/所有PP加4。真正死亡入落败，自己4回期限、对手决斗解除、标准被击败反制抑制；2243即时重生不视实际死亡。
review.deferredBehavior: 真实再次登场决斗判定及骑士落败下场保留/离场期限；己方危机感、真实己方最后一只时落败失效，最后存活时致死保1并每次失速170至0失效的真实队伍条件。
review.trigger: 每次登场；自身为己方最后一只存活精灵；骑士决斗·落败的己方危机感与下场保留
futureMechanisms: 真实换入换出和落败时限
真实队伍危机感及最后存活条件
队伍条件下致死保1/失速170/速度归零失效
落败对真实再次登场后击败/被击败类效果的生命周期

success.name: 4911真实2097首次双方骑士决斗，双方下次实际使用技能转化真实第五但PP沿原选择槽、排序采用第五先制
success.assertion: test('4911真实2097首次双方骑士决斗，双方下次实际使用技能转化真实第五但PP沿原选择槽、排序采用第五先制',()=>{const s=make({move:10001,soul:true}),seen=[];assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>f.soulState.knightDuel4911.kind==='duel'));observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse')seen.push([c.a.side,c.m.wikiId,c.m.id,c.m.duelFifth4911]);},()=>turn(s,10001,20309));assert.deepEqual(seen.map(x=>x.slice(0,2)),[[1,37911],[0,38419]]);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(10001)],34);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38419)],5);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].pp[key(20309)],9);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].pp[key(37911)],5);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>!f.soulState.knightDuel4911.transformNext));assert.ok(s.fighters[1].ailments['冰封']);assert.ok(sum(s)>0);});

success.name: 4911真实2097决斗进入清异常公共状态，已有任一骑士类状态时不重新附双方，未覆盖已有期限
success.assertion: test('4911真实2097决斗进入清异常公共状态，已有任一骑士类状态时不重新附双方，未覆盖已有期限',()=>{const s=make({move:10001,soul:true});s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']=3;s.fighters[1].ailments['中毒']=4;delete s.fighters[0].soulState.knightDuel4911;delete s.fighters[1].soulState.knightDuel4911;E.SOULS.registry[2097].abilities.enter({a:s.fighters[0],t:s.fighters[1],round:1});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['中毒'],undefined);s.fighters[0].soulState.knightDuel4911={kind:'defeat',end:4};delete s.fighters[1].soulState.knightDuel4911;E.SOULS.registry[2097].abilities.enter({a:s.fighters[0],t:s.fighters[1],round:2});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.knightDuel4911.end,4);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.knightDuel4911,undefined);});

success.name: 4911真实2097决斗控制未用与药剂保留下次转化，整招无效实际使用消费；无可选第五阻止技能且不扣原槽PP
success.assertion: test('4911真实2097决斗控制未用与药剂保留下次转化，整招无效实际使用消费；无可选第五阻止技能且不扣原槽PP',()=>{for(const mode of['control','potion','invalid','zeroFifth']){const s=make({move:10001,soul:true});if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=1;if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,0,'skillBlock');if(mode==='zeroFifth')s.fighters[0].pp[key(38419)]=0;turn(s,mode==='potion'?null:10001,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.knightDuel4911.transformNext,mode!=='invalid');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(10001)],mode==='invalid'?34:35);if(mode==='zeroFifth')assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38419)],0);}});

success.name: 4911真实2097高体回合开始全一及所有PP加4上限，不以第五后续清回合强化冒充回合开始；相等两分支均不触发
success.assertion: test('4911真实2097高体回合开始全一及所有PP加4上限，不以第五后续清回合强化冒充回合开始；相等两分支均不触发',()=>{for(const high of[false,true]){const s=make({move:10001,soul:true,targetHp:high?8999:9000});for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=1;let captured;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='roundStart'&&c.a.side===0)captured={stages:{...c.a.stages},pp:{...c.a.pp},snap:{...c.a.soulState.starlight4911}};},()=>turn(s,10001,20309));for(const k of keys)assert.equal(captured.stages[k],high?1:0);for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)assert.equal(captured.pp[k],high?Math.min(5,s.moveDefinitions[k].pp):1);assert.equal(captured.snap.high,high);assert.equal(captured.snap.low,false);}});

success.name: 4911真实2097低体按回合开始快照全技先制1并无视敌双防正强，面板相同时实际红伤一致
success.assertion: test('4911真实2097低体按回合开始快照全技先制1并无视敌双防正强，面板相同时实际红伤一致',()=>{const enemySource=require('../research/BATCH-4816-REMAINING/4909/snapshot.json'),opts={move:10001,soul:true,hp:8999,enemySource,enemyLoadout:[38414,10086,29365,29366,38413]},a=make(opts),b=make(opts);a.fighters[1].stages.def=6;a.fighters[1].stages.spd=6;turn(a,10001,10086);turn(b,10001,10086);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,1);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.starlight4911.low,true);assert.equal(sum(a),sum(b));assert.ok(sum(a)>0);});

success.name: 4911真实决斗当前死亡转落败且解除对手决斗，自身落败4回记录、公共被击败反制被抑制，不凭单挑推断最后存活保1
success.assertion: test('4911真实决斗当前死亡转落败且解除对手决斗，自身落败4回记录、公共被击败反制被抑制，不凭单挑推断最后存活保1',()=>{for(const dead of[0,1]){const s=make({move:10001,soul:true,hp:dead===0?1:9000,targetHp:dead===1?1:9000});timer(s,dead,'被击败疲惫对手',{duration:3});turn(s,10001,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[dead].hp,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[dead].soulState.knightDuel4911.kind,'defeat');assert.equal(s.fighters[dead].soulState.defeatEffectsSuppressed,true);assert.equal(s.fighters[1-dead].soulState.knightDuel4911,undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[1-dead].ailments['疲惫'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[dead].soulState.knightDuel4911.end,dead===0?4:undefined);}});

success.assertion: test('4911真实2097高体回合开始全一及所有PP加4上限，不以第五后续清回合强化冒充回合开始；相等两分支均不触发',()=>{for(const high of[false,true]){const s=make({move:10001,soul:true,targetHp:high?8999:9000});for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=1;let captured;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='roundStart'&&c.a.side===0)captured={stages:{...c.a.stages},pp:{...c.a.pp},snap:{...c.a.soulState.starlight4911}};},()=>turn(s,10001,20309));for(const k of keys)assert.equal(captured.stages[k],high?1:0);for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)assert.equal(captured.pp[k],high?Math.min(5,s.moveDefinitions[k].pp):1);assert.equal(captured.snap.high,high);assert.equal(captured.snap.low,false);}});

success.name: 4911全部17招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制状态，2097原生17种选择转化真实第五且按原槽PP消费
success.assertion: test('4911全部17招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制状态，2097原生17种选择转化真实第五且按原槽PP消费',()=>{require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true}),pp=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]),compiled.operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]));turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],pp-1);if(!m.fifth)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38419)],5);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.knightDuel4911.transformNext,false);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.knightIce2505.knownCommonFirst,true);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.knightIce2505.quota,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.knightIce2505.used,1);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].ailments['冰封']);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}});

success.assertion: test('4911/2076当次起四回最大HP三分一百分比吸取、严格半体以下翻倍，免粉不减理论回复且场下回复仅真实延期请求',()=>{for(const mode of['low','half','immune','overkill','ban']){const s=make({...row(2076),hp:mode==='half'?4500:1000,targetHp:mode==='overkill'?1:9000});if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');if(mode==='ban')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20117);const n=mode==='half'?3000:6000;assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),mode==='immune'?0:n);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='ban'?1000:(mode==='half'?4500:1000)+n);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[0].soulState.starBench2076,mode==='immune');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['星光用招低体比例吸取'].end,4);}});

success.assertion: test('4911/693下两回红增100%、843两种真实技能全先制2和1均到期，2247真实队伍最后存活不从单挑推定',()=>{const a=make({...row(693),loadout:[29369,10001,29370,38418,38419]}),b=make({...row(693),index:-1,loadout:[29369,10001,29370,38418,38419]});turn(a,a.auditMoveId,20309);turn(b,b.auditMoveId,20309);for(let r=2;r<=4;r++){turn(a,10001,20309);turn(b,10001,20309);if(r<=3){assert.ok(sum(a)>=sum(b)*2-1);assert.ok(sum(a)<=sum(b)*2+1);}else assert.equal(sum(a),sum(b));}for(const move of[29370,25563]){const index=source.moves.find(m=>m.id===move).effectInstances.findIndex(e=>e.id===843),s=make({move,index,loadout:[29370,25563,10001,29369,38419]});turn(s,move,20309);for(let r=2;r<=4;r++){turn(s,10001,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,r<=3?(move===29370?2:1):0);}}const s=make(row(2247));turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,0);});

success.assertion: test('4911全部17招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制状态，2097原生17种选择转化真实第五且按原槽PP消费',()=>{require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true}),pp=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]),compiled.operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]));turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],pp-1);if(!m.fifth)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38419)],5);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.knightDuel4911.transformNext,false);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.knightIce2505.knownCommonFirst,true);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.knightIce2505.quota,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.knightIce2505.used,1);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].ailments['冰封']);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}});

success.assertion: test('4911/693下两回红增100%、843两种真实技能全先制2和1均到期，2247真实队伍最后存活不从单挑推定',()=>{const a=make({...row(693),loadout:[29369,10001,29370,38418,38419]}),b=make({...row(693),index:-1,loadout:[29369,10001,29370,38418,38419]});turn(a,a.auditMoveId,20309);turn(b,b.auditMoveId,20309);for(let r=2;r<=4;r++){turn(a,10001,20309);turn(b,10001,20309);if(r<=3){assert.ok(sum(a)>=sum(b)*2-1);assert.ok(sum(a)<=sum(b)*2+1);}else assert.equal(sum(a),sum(b));}for(const move of[29370,25563]){const index=source.moves.find(m=>m.id===move).effectInstances.findIndex(e=>e.id===843),s=make({move,index,loadout:[29370,25563,10001,29369,38419]});turn(s,move,20309);for(let r=2;r<=4;r++){turn(s,10001,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,r<=3?(move===29370?2:1):0);}}const s=make(row(2247));turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,0);});

success.name: 4911/2142真实忽略敌正先制等级而保留自身源先制，1874攻击负等级视正不改真实值，733反弱成功冰封且禁强失败
success.assertion: test('4911/2142真实忽略敌正先制等级而保留自身源先制，1874攻击负等级视正不改真实值，733反弱成功冰封且禁强失败',()=>{const s=make(row(2142));turn(s,s.auditMoveId,37911);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,0);const a=make(row(1874)),b=make({...row(1874),index:-1});a.fighters[0].stages.atk=-2;b.fighters[0].stages.atk=2;turn(a,a.auditMoveId,20309);turn(b,b.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(sum(a),sum(b));assert.equal(a.fighters[0].stages.atk,-2);for(const ban of[false,true]){const s=make(row(733));s.fighters[0].stages.def=-2;if(ban)timer(s,0,'禁强化');turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.def,ban?-2:2);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['冰封'],!ban);}});

success.assertion: test('4911全部17招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制状态，2097原生17种选择转化真实第五且按原槽PP消费',()=>{require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true}),pp=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]),compiled.operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]));turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],pp-1);if(!m.fifth)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38419)],5);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.knightDuel4911.transformNext,false);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.knightIce2505.knownCommonFirst,true);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.knightIce2505.quota,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.knightIce2505.used,1);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].ailments['冰封']);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}});

instance.description: 令对手冰封，自身每有170点速度值，每次在场限1次

raw.description: 消除对手回合类效果，消除成功则自身全属性+1；消除对手能力提升状态，消除成功则自身免疫下1次受到的异常状态；对手体力上限高于1700则造成的攻击伤害提升170%，对手体力上限低于1700则附加自身速度值17%的百分比伤害；给对手造成伤害时，伤害数值的170%恢复自身体力；令对手冰封，自身每有170点速度值，每次在场限1次

metadata.template: 令对手{0}，自身每有{1}点{2}值，每次在场限{3}次

review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.rationale: 2505按面板入场快照并且免疫消费已答，当前速度等级/后续面板变化均不影响；后续真实换入另延期。
review.singleBehavior: 按首次入场速度面板floor(speed/170)个额度，每次命中尝试冰封消费1次，被免疫仍消费；低于170零额度、不按能力等级改变，入场后面板变化不重算；无效/未用不消费。
review.deferredBehavior: 每次真实再次入场时重新保存速度面板快照并重置本次在场已消费额度。
futureMechanisms: 跨离场和再次登场的速度快照及消费

success.name: 4911/2505入场面板速度额度2，免异仍扣额度，第三次不再附冰封且169速度无额度
success.assertion: test('4911/2505入场面板速度额度2，免异仍扣额度，第三次不再附冰封且169速度无额度',()=>{for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make(row(2505));if(immune)s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['冰封'],!immune);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.knightIce2505.firstApplied,!immune);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.knightIce2505.quota,2);delete s.fighters[1].ailments['冰封'];turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.knightIce2505.used,2);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].ailments['冰封']);delete s.fighters[1].ailments['冰封'];turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.knightIce2505.used,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['冰封'],undefined);}const s=make({...row(2505),aStats:{spe:169}});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.knightIce2505.quota,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.knightIce2505.used,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['冰封'],undefined);});

success.assertion: test('4911已答2505允许当前真实版本通过存储校验，错误版本及实例参数仍明确拒绝',()=>{const store=require('../local-species.cjs');assert.deepEqual(store.issues(source),[]);for(const mode of['version','args']){const bad=structuredClone(source),move=bad.moves.find(m=>m.id===38419);if(mode==='version'){move.hash='bad';move.revision='seerapi:bad';}else move.effectInstances[4].args[1]=171;assert.ok(store.issues(bad).length>0);assert.throws(()=>E.WIKI.effectsEngine.registry[2505].validate(move.effectInstances[4].args,move,4),/2505仅核实/);}});

success.name: 4911已答2505入场速度面板每170一额度：169/170/339/340/509/510边界、正零负速度等级均不改，后续改面板也不重算
success.assertion: test('4911已答2505入场速度面板每170一额度：169/170/339/340/509/510边界、正零负速度等级均不改，后续改面板也不重算',()=>{for(const speed of[169,170,339,340,509,510])for(const rank of[-6,0,6]){const s=make({move:38419,index:4,aStats:{spe:speed}}),quota=Math.floor(speed/170);s.fighters[0].stages.spe=rank;s.fighters[0].stats.spe=999;for(let i=0;i<=quota;i++){delete s.fighters[1].ailments['冰封'];turn(s,38419,20309);const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.knightIce2505;assert.equal(st.entrySpeed,speed);assert.equal(st.quota,quota);assert.equal(st.used,Math.min(i+1,quota));assert.equal(st.attempts.length,Math.min(i+1,quota));assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['冰封'],i<quota);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.entryPanelSpeed2505,speed);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38419)],5-i-1);}}});

success.name: 4911已答2505被免疫仍消费，次数/回合免异不预滤不补额度，整招无效不消费且控制未用不消费
success.assertion: test('4911已答2505被免疫仍消费，次数/回合免异不预滤不补额度，整招无效不消费且控制未用不消费',()=>{for(const mode of['count','timed','invalid','control']){const s=make({move:38419,index:4,aStats:{spe:170},hit:true});if(mode==='count')s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;if(mode==='timed')timer(s,1,'免异常');if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,0,'skillBlock');if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=1;turn(s,38419,20309);if(['invalid','control'].includes(mode)){assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.knightIce2505,undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38419)],mode==='control'?5:4);}else{assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.knightIce2505.used,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.knightIce2505.firstApplied,false);delete s.fighters[1].effects['免异常'];turn(s,38419,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['冰封'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.knightIce2505.attempts.length,1);if(mode==='count')assert.equal(s.fighters[1].counts.immune,0);}}});

interaction.assertion: test('4911已答2505被免疫仍消费，次数/回合免异不预滤不补额度，整招无效不消费且控制未用不消费',()=>{for(const mode of['count','timed','invalid','control']){const s=make({move:38419,index:4,aStats:{spe:170},hit:true});if(mode==='count')s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;if(mode==='timed')timer(s,1,'免异常');if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,0,'skillBlock');if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=1;turn(s,38419,20309);if(['invalid','control'].includes(mode)){assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.knightIce2505,undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38419)],mode==='control'?5:4);}else{assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.knightIce2505.used,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.knightIce2505.firstApplied,false);delete s.fighters[1].effects['免异常'];turn(s,38419,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['冰封'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.knightIce2505.attempts.length,1);if(mode==='count')assert.equal(s.fighters[1].counts.immune,0);}}});
